patterns.name: Abandonment Fear Pattern
patterns.headline: कहीं वह मुझे छोड़ न दे।
patterns.shortDescription: You may notice a deep sensitivity to signs of distance or withdrawal from people you care about — even small ones — and a strong pull to hold on tightly when that happens.
experiencePoints: A racing sense of worry when someone goes quiet or takes longer to reply
Difficulty relaxing into closeness without wondering when it might end
A tendency to seek frequent reassurance that the relationship is okay
Reading distance into ordinary, unrelated silences
Relief that can feel almost as intense as the original worry, once reassured

cycle.trigger: Someone you care about seems distant or slow to respond
cycle.thought: "कहीं वह मुझे छोड़ न दे।" — They might be pulling away from me
cycle.reaction: Seeking reassurance, checking in repeatedly, or pre-emptively withdrawing first
cycle.impact: The relationship can start to feel more effortful, for both people
cycle.repeat: The next sign of distance — real or imagined — restarts the cycle

patterns.name: Overthinking & Anxiety Pattern
patterns.headline: इसका मतलब क्या है?
patterns.shortDescription: You may find your mind replaying conversations and moments long after they're over, searching for hidden meaning in things that were said — or left unsaid.
experiencePoints: Re-reading messages multiple times, looking for a different meaning
Rehearsing conversations before they happen, and replaying them after
Feeling mentally tired from thinking through the same situation repeatedly
Struggling to simply take a neutral comment at face value
Noticing your mind jumps to worst-case interpretations
triggers: A shift in someone's usual tone

cycle.trigger: An ambiguous comment, message, or change in behaviour
cycle.thought: "इसका मतलब क्या है?" — What does this actually mean?
cycle.reaction: Analysing, re-reading, searching for clarity or hidden signals
cycle.impact: Mental energy goes into analysis rather than the relationship itself
cycle.repeat: The next ambiguous moment reopens the same search for meaning

patterns.name: Self-Worth Pattern
patterns.headline: क्या मैं पर्याप्त हूं?
patterns.shortDescription: You may notice your sense of being "enough" in a relationship shifting based on how the other person responds to you, rather than staying steady on its own.
experiencePoints: Measuring your value by how much attention or affection you're receiving
Comparing yourself to others the person you care about is close to
A quiet, persistent question of whether you're truly wanted
Difficulty accepting compliments or reassurance at face value
Feeling especially low after any perceived rejection, however small

cycle.trigger: A moment of comparison, criticism, or feeling overlooked
cycle.thought: "क्या मैं पर्याप्त हूं?" — Am I enough?
cycle.reaction: Withdrawing, over-trying to prove your worth, or seeking validation
cycle.impact: Your sense of self becomes tied to someone else's response
cycle.repeat: The next comparison or perceived slight reopens the same question

patterns.name: Trust & Emotional Protection Pattern
patterns.headline: क्या मैं इस व्यक्ति पर भरोसा कर सकता/सकती हूं?
patterns.shortDescription: You may find yourself keeping a careful emotional distance, even in relationships that matter to you — staying alert, just in case.
experiencePoints: Holding a part of yourself back, even when things are going well
Watching closely for signs that someone might let you down
Difficulty fully relaxing into trust, even over time
A tendency to test whether someone is reliable before opening up
Feeling safer when you keep some emotional independence
triggers: Past experiences resurfacing in a new relationship
Being let down in a small way
Pressure to commit or open up

cycle.trigger: A moment that asks for trust or vulnerability
cycle.thought: "क्या मैं इस व्यक्ति पर भरोसा कर सकता/सकती हूं?" — Can I trust this person?
cycle.reaction: Holding back, staying alert, keeping some distance as protection
cycle.impact: Closeness can feel capped, even in safe relationships
cycle.repeat: The next opportunity for closeness triggers the same caution

patterns.name: People-Pleasing & Boundary Pattern
patterns.headline: Relationship ठीक रखने के लिए मुझे कितना adjust करना चाहिए?
patterns.shortDescription: You may notice yourself adjusting your own needs, opinions, or plans to keep the peace — sometimes before you've even considered what you actually want.
experiencePoints: Saying yes when you would rather say no
Feeling responsible for other people's moods
Difficulty naming your own needs, even to yourself
Avoiding disagreement even on things that matter to you
Feeling resentment build up after repeatedly accommodating others
triggers: Being asked for something you don't want to give
Disagreement or conflict beginning to surface
Fear of being seen as difficult

cycle.trigger: A request, disagreement, or sign that someone is unhappy
cycle.thought: "Relationship ठीक रखने के लिए मुझे कितना adjust करना चाहिए?" — How much should I adjust to keep this okay?
cycle.emotion: Discomfort, guilt, a pull to smooth things over
cycle.reaction: Accommodating, agreeing, setting your own needs aside
cycle.impact: Your own needs stay unspoken and can quietly build into resentment
cycle.repeat: The next request or disagreement restarts the same adjustment

patterns.name: Repeating Relationship Pattern
patterns.headline: लोग बदलते हैं, लेकिन कहानी वही क्यों रहती है?
patterns.shortDescription: You may notice a familiar shape to your relationships — different people, but a similar story playing out: the same kind of ending, the same kind of hurt, or the same kind of dynamic.
experiencePoints: Noticing the same conflict or disappointment showing up in different relationships
Feeling drawn to familiar dynamics, even when they haven't worked before
A sense of déjà vu in how relationships tend to unfold
Difficulty identifying what, specifically, keeps repeating
Wondering why circumstances change but outcomes don't
triggers: The early stage of a new relationship starting to feel familiar
Recognising a dynamic from a past relationship
A relationship ending in a familiar way
Others pointing out a pattern you hadn't named

cycle.trigger: A new relationship or situation begins to unfold
cycle.thought: "लोग बदलते हैं, लेकिन कहानी वही क्यों रहती है?" — People change, so why does the story stay the same?
cycle.reaction: Falling into familiar roles or choices without fully deciding to
cycle.impact: The same kind of ending or difficulty tends to resurface
cycle.repeat: The next relationship or situation begins the cycle again
